name: Doctor Boat Control Marine Intelligence V6.0
release_notes: Built-in DR Boat Vector Chart Manager.
S-57 ENC vector charts can be loaded and rendered inside DR Boat through GDAL conversion.
GeoJSON vector charts render directly on the UTM map.
Route, Track, Measure Distance and vessel overlays remain available above chart layers.
CM93 databases are detected and indexed; native CM93 decoding is not falsely simulated.
Installer adds gdal-bin and preserves positioning, routes and track history.
